title: Wall Mounted Paper Towel Holder 15.5-Inch | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Brass Paper Towel Holders | Allied Brass
body_html:
Free up countertop space and keep paper towels right where you cook, prep, and clean in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any kitchens. This wall mount paper towel holder delivers an industrial pipe-fitting look designed to blend with both modern and traditional kitchen decor.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
  • Cleaner-looking finish — protected with a highly durable powder coat for a decorative, clean appearance.
  • Made for daily use — quality materials resist corrosion and rust for continual service.
  • Secure, matched installation — mounts firmly with color coordinated screws and included mounting hardware.

Specs & Details
Mounting: Wall mount
Dimensions (L x H x W): 15.5 x 3 x 4 in.
Shipping weight: 1.3 lbs
Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
19 designer finish options available
